Today's selection covers 83 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 56 on Artificial Intelligence and 14 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: In Race With U.S., China Struggles to Recruit Foreign A.I. Researchers

• **Security Alert**: Lego fraudster among last year's most high-profile insurance scammers

• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, BBC Technology, Ars Technica, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 52 articles published in the last 24 hours
